newsitem.title: USA: Glimcher completes part of mall financing.
newsitem.headline: Glimcher completes part of mall financing.

text.p: Glimcher Realty Trust said on Tuesday it completed part of a previously announced transaction with a U.S. affiliate of Nomura Securities Co Ltd to fund development of new shopping centers.
The real estate investment trust said it received the part of an equity financing agreement from Nomura Asset Capital Corp for a shopping center project underway in Kansas.

On September 18, Glimcher said that as a first step in a larger financing agreement, Nomura Asset would provide $135 million in equity financing for three projects underway in Kansas City, Elizabeth, N.J. and Carson, Calif.
Under the terms of the agreement, Nomura completed an initial purchase of 34,000 shares of preferred stock from Glimcher at a cost of about $34 million, the REIT said.

Proceeds from the offering have been invested in the Great Mall of the Great Plains project in Olathe, Kansas, it said. Both Glimcher and Nomura have a 45 percent share in the venture, and a minority partner holds the remaining 10 percent, Glimcher said.
